text:
mira: Hey team — HealthCorp POC: they're trying to ship logs + traces into Sysdig but are missing trace_id in a subset of logs and seeing intermittent 429s on the log-drain. Can SEs + SRE help triage before the customer call?

sam: On it. Are they using our HTTP log-drain or the console's forwarder?

mira: HTTP log-drain to their collector. They said missing trace ids mainly for background workers and some short spikes produce 429s. Also asked about PII redaction in the pipeline.

alex: Common pattern: background jobs lose request context. Two quick checks: 1) ensure the trace id is passed when enqueuing jobs, 2) if they use our SDK, call `redwood.context.propagate()` before job dispatch. Example snippet:```python
# when creating a background job from a request handler
trace = request.headers.get('x-redwood-trace')
job_payload = {'user_id': uid, 'body': body}
headers = {'x-redwood-trace': trace}
enqueue_job(job_payload, headers=headers)
```
That will let the worker pick up trace header and include it in emitted logs.

jen: Do we have a quick live-tail link for them? I can share during the call.

alex: Use the project's live tail: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/healthcorp/live-tail — filter by `trace_id:` once we send a unique value.

alex: About the 429s: 99% of the time those are rate limits on the ingest side (Sysdig) or transient network. Our drain client does 3 retries with exponential backoff by default. Options: ask customer to increase ingest quota, enable buffering on their side, or we can temporarily raise the drain allowance on our side for the POC. I can bump it for a short window.

carl: On PII/redaction — we support transformation rules on export. You can add field removal or regex scrubbing in Console -> Exports -> Transformations. Example YAML transform they can apply before egress:```yaml
- remove_field: social_security_number
- redact_regex:
    pattern: "(?i)password\s*[:=]\s*\S+"
    replace_with: "[REDACTED]"
```
We can also add an export-level consent note for compliance teams.

mira: Perfect. Can someone do an 11:00am PT session? They'll want to watch a trace go all the way through and confirm no 429s. :calendar: @sam @alex

sam: I can run the walkthrough and coordinate access. Alex — can you toggle the drain quota now?

alex: Yup. Bumping `hc-poc` drain quota to 250 req/s for 2h. Watching tail and error rate.

deploy-bot: Quota update applied: `hc-poc` drain_rate 100->250 req/s by alex at 1958765920 UTC.

alex: Also sending them a quick verification command to hit from their dev box so we can spot a unique trace in live-tail:```bash
curl -s -H "x-redwood-trace: HC-TEST-$(date +%s)" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
```
Then search live-tail for that HC-TEST token.

mira: I'll schedule the 11am PT slot and send the link. After the call we'll mark this resolved once trace shows up in live-tail and 429s stop for the session. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll also forward the security redaction snippet to their security contact and add a short checklist in the shared drive: checklist = ["verify trace in live-tail","confirm no 429s during burst test","agree on redaction rules"]

mira: Awesome — closing loop after the walkthrough. If anything flares up ping #eng-oncall.
